[Pedagogy audit v2 · New question to decide] For the type count gap (back-to-back-construct). Comparison score 29, between p31-q15 and A3: Students must split raw unordered data for two groups into tens and units, order the leaves on both sides of the stem and keep repeats. A short count then compares the classes. This is routine linked procedure with a drawn frame and stems supplied. It needs a little more than reading a plot but no reframing.
Proposed question: [object Object]
a) Construct a back-to-back stem-and-leaf plot for the travel time data. (with a diagram)
b) Which class has more students who travel for 30 minutes or more?
Answers: a) Stem 1: 9A leaves 8, 4, 3; 9B leaves 6, 9. Stem 2: 9A 9, 7, 2, 2; 9B 1, 1, 4, 6. Stem 3: 9A 5, 5; 9B 3, 8. Stem 4: 9A 1; 9B 0, 5.; b) Class 9B.

Proposed question: [object Object]

Answers: a) Stem 2: A leaves 8, 4; B leaves 9, 9. Stem 3: A 9, 6, 2; B 0, 5, 7. Stem 4: A 7, 5, 5; B 1, 4, 8. Stem 5: A 2, 1; B 3, 6.; b) 5 days.
